notes.notes: Try the new Buntasy mini-game demo!

notes.title: Demo is out for Buntasy!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! The demo for our upcoming game Buntasy is finally out. Please try it out and let us know of any bugs or suggestions you have for the game! 

The demo will be available for 3-4 weeks so make sure you don't miss out on all the fun!

Enjoy!
